name: Caddie Rory

intro.text: I carry bags round the Old Course in the summer. I know every bump. Want to know which way the putt breaks? Towards the sea. It always breaks towards the sea.

win: Aye, you read that one well.
after: Old Tom Morris was greenkeeper here for nearly forty years, and he won the Open four times. His son, Young Tom, won it four times too, and he was only twenty-four when he died.
